orphanFallback.rationale: Even without the earlier analogy, the source supplies a general positive account of reliable inference as assembled from demonstrable, convergent evidential components.

orphanFallback.rationale: The examples of friction, nuclear forces, molecular behavior, and water cutting metal directly ground a mind-independent account of causal capacity.
